power.charpowers.pounce.desc: Leap up to 6 blocks onto your target: 2.5 hearts when you land. 8 s cooldown
power.charpowers.blink_strike.desc: Teleport behind whatever you look at (16 blocks) and hit it: 4 hearts. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.boulder_toss.desc: Tear up a chunk of ground beside you and throw it up to 20 blocks: 4 hearts where it lands. The hole stays. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.flame_breath.desc: Breathe fire for 3 s (5 blocks): half a heart every half second and they burn. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.shock_palm.desc: Palm strike: 4 hearts, then a zap jumps to 2 things nearby for 2 hearts each. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.earth_spikes.desc: Stone spikes burst up under your target (16 blocks): 4 hearts. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.whirlwind.desc: Spin for 3 s, hitting everything within 3 blocks for 1 heart every half second. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.shockwave_stomp.desc: Stomp: everything within 5 blocks takes 3 hearts and is thrown up. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.piercing_bolt.desc: A bolt flies 30 blocks through everything in its way: 3 hearts each. 12 s cooldown
power.charpowers.iron_fist.desc: Your hits do 1.5 extra hearts and knock shields down like an axe
power.charpowers.bleed.desc: Your hits make them bleed: half a heart a second for 3 s (up to 3 bleeds at once)
power.charpowers.grab_and_throw.desc: Grab what's in front of you and hurl it 10 blocks: 3 hearts, plus the fall. 15 s cooldown
power.charpowers.venom_spit.desc: Spit venom up to 15 blocks: 1 heart and Poison II for 5 s. 12 s cooldown
power.charpowers.lunge.desc: Dash 8 blocks forward: everything you pass through takes 3 hearts. 12 s cooldown
power.charpowers.crushing_grip.desc: Hold your target still for 2 s, crushing it for 2 hearts a second. 20 s cooldown
power.charpowers.meteor_punch.desc: Jump high and slam down where you look (20 blocks): 6 hearts within 4 blocks and a small crater. 30 s cooldown
power.charpowers.chain_zap.desc: A zap jumps between up to 5 targets: 4 hearts each. No lightning bolt, no flash. 25 s cooldown
power.charpowers.blade_storm.desc: 8 spinning swords circle you for 5 s: 2 hearts to anything they touch (once a second each). 30 s cooldown
power.charpowers.dragon_breath.desc: Breathe dragon breath for 3 s (8 blocks): 6 hearts in all, and a purple cloud hangs there. 30 s cooldown
power.charpowers.shadow_step.desc: Teleport behind your target (24 blocks): 6 hearts and Blindness for 2 s. 25 s cooldown
power.charpowers.earthquake.desc: The ground within 8 blocks rumbles and cracks: 5 hearts, everything thrown up, and bits of the ground break. 40 s cooldown
power.charpowers.ice_spear.desc: Throw a huge ice spear (24 blocks): 7 hearts and it's frozen still for 3 s. 25 s cooldown
power.charpowers.volley.desc: 12 arrows rain down around your target: 1 heart each. 25 s cooldown
power.charpowers.bone_cage.desc: Trap your target in a bone cage for 3 s, then it bursts inward: 5 hearts. 30 s cooldown
power.charpowers.rampage.desc: Each kill within 10 s of the last adds 1 heart to your hits (up to 5 extra)
power.charpowers.execute.desc: Your hits do double damage to anything under a quarter of its health
power.charpowers.wrecking_ball.desc: A heavy iron ball rolls 15 blocks forward, smashing through blocks and hitting everything for 6 hearts. 40 s cooldown
power.charpowers.behind_you.desc: Teleport behind your target (32 blocks): 10 hearts, or 20 if it wasn't fighting you. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.thousand_fists.desc: 20 punches in 2 seconds (half a heart each) while your target is held in place. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.crater_leap.desc: Leap up to 20 blocks to where you look: 8 hearts within 5 blocks where you land, and a crater. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.power_beam.desc: Charge for 1 s, then fire a 30-block beam for 2 s: up to 12 hearts, and it bores a tunnel. 75 s cooldown
power.charpowers.black_hole_fist.desc: A tiny black hole opens at your target for 3 s: it pulls everything in and hurts what gets close (up to 12 hearts). 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.thunder_hammer.desc: Wind up for 1 s, then slam: 8 hearts within 4 blocks, and they're stunned for 2 s. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.tidal_wave.desc: A wave 10 blocks wide rolls 20 blocks forward: 6 hearts and it sweeps everything along. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.blood_pact.desc: Your hits do 50% more damage, but each one costs you a quarter heart (it can't kill you)
power.charpowers.explosive_fist.desc: Your next punch within 10 s explodes: 10 hearts to it, 4 to things nearby, and it blows a hole. 60 s cooldown
power.charpowers.sword_rain.desc: 20 swords rain down around your target over 3 s: 2 hearts each hit. 75 s cooldown
power.charpowers.sky_splitter.desc: A warning line on the ground, then a giant blade falls along 20 blocks: 15 hearts, and it cuts a deep trench. 2 min cooldown
power.charpowers.meteor.desc: Call a meteor where you look (40 blocks): a 3 s shadow, then 18 hearts within 4 blocks and a big crater. 3 min cooldown
power.charpowers.vanish_strike.desc: Teleport behind up to 5 targets in a row (within 20 blocks): 8 hearts each. 2 min cooldown
power.charpowers.titan_grip.desc: Grab your target, lift it 15 blocks into the air and slam it down: 15 hearts plus the fall. 2 min cooldown
power.charpowers.shockwave_roar.desc: Roar in a 15-block cone: 12 hearts, knocked back 10 blocks, and glass, leaves and plants shatter. 2 min cooldown
power.charpowers.overcharge_beam.desc: Charge for 2 s (you glow), then fire a 50-block beam 3 wide: 20 hearts, and it blasts a tunnel. 3 min cooldown
power.charpowers.death_mark.desc: Mark your target. If you're still within 50 blocks 5 s later, it takes 20 hearts. 3 min cooldown
power.charpowers.berserker.desc: For 15 s every hit does 5 extra hearts, you can't be knocked back and you swing faster. Then you're weak for 10 s. 3 min cooldown
power.charpowers.ground_slam.desc: Rip a 10x10 hunk of ground up over your head, then press again to slam it down where you look: 50 hearts under it, 10 around it. The hole and the crater stay. 10 min cooldown
power.charpowers.vanishing_blow.desc: Teleport behind your target (64 blocks); everything nearby freezes for 1 s, then the blow lands: 40 hearts. 5 min cooldown
power.charpowers.planet_cracker.desc: Wind up for 2 s, then punch the ground: a huge crater, 35 hearts within 8 blocks and 10 within 16. 10 min cooldown
power.charpowers.starfall.desc: 10 meteors rain down around your target over 5 s: 12 hearts each and a crater each. 10 min cooldown
power.charpowers.void_rend.desc: Tear a rift at your target: it pulls everything in for 3 s, then snaps shut for 40 hearts and erases the ground around it. 10 min cooldown
power.charpowers.one_punch.desc: Your next punch within 10 s does 50 hearts and sends it flying 30 blocks. Miss and it's wasted. 10 min cooldown
gui.charpowers.how: Click a power, then a slot
gui.charpowers.pick_slot: Now click a slot for it
ability.charpowers.clone.desc: Summon a clone that looks exactly like you. If you're under attack it starts on Attack. If one dies, it can't come back for a Minecraft day. Crouch + right-click a clone for its menu. In the Clones menu you can give them nicknames and tick which ones come.
ability.charpowers.escaped_death.desc: Mastery 40. Switch on: when a hit would kill you, a copy appears and dies instead. 1 minute cooldown.
ability.charpowers.dog_pile.desc: Mastery 60. Your clones go home and 20 copies wearing your gear fight for 60 seconds. Also lets Clone summon up to 3 at once. 5 minute cooldown.
ability.charpowers.mastery_share.desc: When you dismiss a clone, you get all the XP and mastery it gathered.
ability.charpowers.clone_level_up.desc: Mastery 20. You can have 2 clones out.
ability.charpowers.power_clone.desc: Mastery 80. Put an item that gives a power in a clone's marked chest and it takes the power. 20% chance it goes rogue and fights you to the death (5% at mastery 100).
power.charpowers.cloning.about: Make more of yourself and give the clones jobs: follow, fight, mine, chop and cook. They look just like you, use your gear and eat your food. Hold V (the order wheel) to send every clone to Follow, Mine, Chop, Cook, Guard, Farm or Come home. Guard stays at one spot and fights what comes near, then walks back. Farm picks ripe crops near the spot, plants the same crop again and puts the harvest in the marked chest.
power.charpowers.cloning.how: Around midnight (moon high, about 17000 to 19000 on the clock), stand still for 60 seconds looking at glass with water close behind it. A wall on the shore with the water just behind or below works. Any glass counts.
power.charpowers.cloning.mastery: 20: 2 clones. 40: Escaped Death. 60: Dog Pile and 3 clones. 80: Power Clone. 100: rogue chance 5%, dead clones come back in half a day. Every level: a bit more clone health.
power.charpowers.cloning.quest: At mastery 100, go back to the glass at midnight with no clones out. Your reflection steps out wearing your gear. Beat it alone.
power.charpowers.cloning.quest_hint: Mastery 100: face your reflection at midnight, alone
power.charpowers.cloning.abilities_text:
Clone: summon a clone. If it dies, its slot locks for a day.
Mastery Share: your clones hand you the mastery and XP they earned when you unsummon them.
Clone Level Up: a second clone.
Escaped Death: a toggle. A hit that would kill you kills a stand-in instead.
Dog Pile: 20 copies of you pile on for 60 seconds, and Clone can bring 3 at once.
Power Clone: give a clone a power item from its chest. It might go rogue.
power.charpowers.teacher.about: A joke power. You can teach anyone any power except Teacher. But you can't have any other powers, so you have nothing to teach. It does nothing at all.
power.charpowers.teacher.how: Trade 50 villagers all the way up to Master, then crouch and right-click a lectern twice to sign. Every other power you have is put away until you quit (crouch and right-click a lectern twice again).
power.charpowers.teacher.mastery: The bar goes up like the others but does nothing. It goes up while you play, and at 100 you get a message.
power.charpowers.teacher.quest: At mastery 100, stand at a lectern for 3 whole Minecraft days (one hour).
power.charpowers.teacher.quest_hint: Mastery 100: stand at a lectern for 3 whole days. You get nothing.
ability.charpowers.teach.desc: Teach anyone any power. You have nothing to teach.
ability.charpowers.no_other_powers.desc: You can't gain any other abilities. That's the rule. Quit at a lectern to get your old ones back.
power.charpowers.teacher.abilities_text:
Teach: Teach anyone any power. You have nothing to teach.
No Other Powers: You can't gain any other abilities. That's the rule. Quit at a lectern to get your old ones back.
power.charpowers.translation.about: Understand animals and mobs. You hear them say things, in voice lines from Char's own recordings (a resource pack). Only you hear them.
power.charpowers.translation.how: Keep a parrot on your shoulder for 20 minutes in total. It can jump off, the time adds up.
power.charpowers.translation.mastery: Every level: you hear mobs from further away (8 to 32 blocks). 25: sad lines start. 50: useful lines start.
power.charpowers.translation.quest: At mastery 100, hear every voice line from every mob in your voice folders at least once. They tick off in Options, Music & Sounds, Mob Voices.
power.charpowers.translation.awakening: Choose which mobs get to speak, in the same list.
power.charpowers.translation.quest_hint: Mastery 100: hear every voice line. See Options, Music & Sounds, Mob Voices.
ability.charpowers.understand_mobs.desc: Mobs near you say things only you can hear. Funny ones to start with.
ability.charpowers.sad_lines.desc: Mastery 25. Some of what they say gets sad.
ability.charpowers.useful_lines.desc: Mastery 50. Sometimes they tell you something useful.
ability.charpowers.choose_voices.desc: Awakened. Pick who gets to speak in Options, Music & Sounds, Mob Voices.

Useful Lines: Mastery 50. Sometimes they tell you something useful.
Choose Voices: Awakened. Pick who gets to speak in Options, Music & Sounds, Mob Voices.
power.charpowers.future_sight.about: You get told things: where ores are while you mine, what is about to hit you in a fight, and which mobs "have something" (a hidden power).
power.charpowers.future_sight.how: Dodge 1,000 skeleton arrows: each one has to fly within half a block of you without hitting.
power.charpowers.future_sight.mastery: Every level: ore hints reach further (8 to 32 blocks) and warnings come earlier (1 to 3 s). 50: it tells you which hidden rank a mob has. 75: ores glow for a moment through walls. 100: it tells you exactly how many.
power.charpowers.future_sight.quest: At mastery 100, win 10 whole raids without being hit once.
power.charpowers.future_sight.awakening: See through the eyes of a player or mob within your render distance.
power.charpowers.future_sight.quest_hint: Mastery 100: win 10 whole raids without being hit.
ability.charpowers.hush.desc: Tells your future sight to be quiet. Press again to listen.
ability.charpowers.ore_hints.desc: While you mine, words tell you what is around you: "diamonds... below and to the left".
ability.charpowers.fight_tips.desc: Warnings before you get hit: "a creeper behind you in 3...", "skeleton aiming at you".
ability.charpowers.sense_powers.desc: A whisper when a mob near you "has something".
ability.charpowers.rank_sense.desc: Mastery 50. It tells you which hidden power rank a mob has (F to B).
ability.charpowers.ore_glow.desc: Mastery 75. Ores near you glow faintly through walls for a moment.
ability.charpowers.ore_count.desc: Mastery 100. It tells you exactly how many are near you.
ability.charpowers.see_through.desc: Awakened. Look at a player or mob and press to see what they see. Press again to come back.

power.charpowers.superior_authority.abou: Make things happen that everyone must obey: nobody can jump, fly or walk. You never have to obey, only others. Players and mobs, friends too.
power.charpowers.superior_authority.how: Build a gold throne: a 3x3 of gold blocks, one more block on your left and right, and a back 3 tall behind the seat (14 blocks). Crouch on the middle block with the back behind you, before the raid's second wave, and stay there until the raid is won.
power.charpowers.superior_authority.mast: Range: +100 blocks every 10 levels (1,000 at 100). Commands last 10 s, up to 1 minute at 100, and the cooldown is the same. 1: Stop, No jumping. 25: Freeze. 50: Kneel. 75: Look at me. 100: Attack.
power.charpowers.superior_authority.ques: At mastery 100, build a superior throne: a 5x5 base, armrests 2 tall, a back 5 tall with a diamond block on top and a 3 tall wing each side. Crouch on it through a whole raid and win using only commands, never hitting anything yourself.
power.charpowers.superior_authority.awak: One more word: Die. It kills every mob and player not in your /team within 100 blocks.
power.charpowers.superior_authority.ques: Mastery 100: win a raid from a superior throne, using only commands.
ability.charpowers.stop.desc: Everyone stops whatever they are doing: mining, sleeping, eating, using items.
ability.charpowers.kneel.desc: Mastery 50. Everyone is forced to crouch.
ability.charpowers.look_at_me.desc: Mastery 75. Every head turns to face you.
ability.charpowers.attack.desc: Mastery 100. Look at someone: everyone near you is forced to attack them, with whatever they are holding.
ability.charpowers.die.desc: Awakened. Kills every mob and player not in your /team within 100 blocks.

power.charpowers.the_miner.about: Mine with your fist like a netherite pickaxe, see in the dark, find more ore, and dig huge shapes with one key. Area abilities only break natural blocks: bricks, planks and cobble are safe, but a base of plain stone or dirt could still break.
power.charpowers.the_miner.how: Mine 4 whole chunks in a 2x2 area, surface to bedrock, by hand. It checks a chunk once you have dug 20,000 blocks in it, and a few leftovers are fine.
power.charpowers.the_miner.mastery: Every 25 levels: another efficiency level (1 at 25, 2 at 50, 3 at 75, 4 at 100).
power.charpowers.the_miner.quest: At mastery 100, have mined 1,000,000 blocks in total. Blocks from Ore Ball do not count.
power.charpowers.the_miner.quest_hint: Mastery 100: mine 1,000,000 blocks in total (Ore Ball blocks do not count).
ability.charpowers.miner_stairs.desc: Mines a staircase down 30 levels, 2 wide, ahead of you.
ability.charpowers.mine_3x3.desc: Mastery 10. A toggle: your mining breaks a 3x3 of natural blocks.
ability.charpowers.mine_ball.desc: Mastery 50. Mines a ball 30 blocks across around you. Everything natural breaks, only ores drop.
ability.charpowers.mine_5x5.desc: Mastery 75. A toggle: your mining breaks a 5x5 of natural blocks.
ability.charpowers.strip_mine.desc: Awakened. A whole chunk gets mined out, top to bottom, in about 30 s. Ores come to you (rarest first); dirt, cobble and other junk drops on the ground.
ability.charpowers.motherlode.desc: Awakened. Every ore within 15 blocks flies into your inventory, and rarest first, and the rock stays where it is. Water and lava next to them is cleared.
ability.charpowers.fist_mining.desc: Your fist mines like a netherite pickaxe.
ability.charpowers.miner_efficiency.desc: You mine faster: efficiency 1 at mastery 25, up to 4 at 100.
ability.charpowers.more_ores.desc: You find more ore than normal, on top of fortune.

power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.about: Just a bunch of quality of life: faster crops, sitting, sleep that helps, petting, soft landings, vein mining, tree chopping, a magnet, chest sorting and an auto tool.
power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.how: Before the sun starts going down, right-click a stair with an empty hand while facing west (the sunset). Keep watching until the sun is gone.
power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.mastery: Every level: crops grow faster in a bigger area (4 to 16 blocks) and Well Rested lasts longer (5 to 20 minutes). 50: petting heals twice as much. 100: soft landing works on grass too.
power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.quest: At mastery 100, sit on a stair from sunrise to sunset with a pet beside you, full hunger and no damage all day, facing east until noon, then west.
power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.awakening: Stronger powers: crops twice as fast, Well Rested half as long again, petting heals double, the magnet and chest sorter reach 16 blocks, vein mining and tree chopping become one: Ultimine (hold the Ultimine key, mouse wheel picks the shape, then mine anything).
power.charpowers.life_enjoyer.quest_hint: Mastery 100: sit on a stair from sunrise to sunset, with a pet, facing the sun.
ability.charpowers.vein_miner.desc: A toggle: mining one ore mines the whole vein. Once awakened it joins Ultimine.
ability.charpowers.tree_logger.desc: A toggle: chop one log and the whole tree comes down. Wooden builds are safe. Once awakened it joins Ultimine.
ability.charpowers.magnet.desc: A toggle: items on the ground within 10 blocks fly to you. Other players' drops wait 5 seconds first.
ability.charpowers.auto_tool.desc: A toggle: the right tool on your hotbar swaps into your hand by itself.
ability.charpowers.chest_sorter.desc: Sorts every chest and barrel within 8 blocks of you with one key.
ability.charpowers.farming.desc: Crops near you grow a bit faster, and broken crops replant themselves.
ability.charpowers.comfy.desc: Right-click stairs and slabs with an empty hand to sit. A good night's sleep makes you Well Rested.
ability.charpowers.animal_friend.desc: Petting an animal (right-click, empty hand) heals both of you a little.
ability.charpowers.soft_landing.desc: No fall damage landing on hay, leaves or wool.
ability.charpowers.easy_walking.desc: No hunger loss while walking, only running.

power.charpowers.vocal_expression.about: Type words in chat and they appear in the world as SOLID letters. Stand on them, build bridges with them, block things with them. Bigger words use more breath.
power.charpowers.vocal_expression.master: Every level: words last longer (10 s to 5 minutes) and cost less breath. Longest word: 5 letters, up to 30 at 100. 50: words hit harder when they shoot out. 100: two words out at once.
power.charpowers.vocal_expression.quest: At mastery 100, cross 200 blocks standing only on your own words, without touching anything else.
power.charpowers.vocal_expression.awaken: Words do what they say when they hit: BURN sets things on fire, ICE and FREEZE freeze, BOOM explodes and breaks blocks. Also GROW (bone meal), BLOOM (flowers), HEAL, PUSH, PULL, JUMP (throws things up), LIGHT (makes things glow), STORM (rain, puts out fires), SLEEP (slows things right down).
power.charpowers.vocal_expression.quest_: Mastery 100: cross a 200 block gap standing only on your own words.
ability.charpowers.speak.desc: A toggle: while on, what you type in chat becomes a word and no one reads it. It shoots out where you look, hits whatever it crashes into, then stays solid. Crouch while you send it to lay it flat ahead of you, as a bridge.
ability.charpowers.hard_words.desc: Mastery 50. Words hit harder when they shoot out.
ability.charpowers.two_words.desc: Mastery 100. Two words out at once.
ability.charpowers.true_words.desc: Awakened. BURN, ICE, FREEZE, BOOM, GROW, BLOOM, HEAL, PUSH, PULL, JUMP, LIGHT, STORM, SLEEP.

power.charpowers.time_control.about: Slow things down, speed things up, and step outside of time.
power.charpowers.time_control.how: Stay in the End for 100 Minecraft days straight (about 33 hours). Leaving the End restarts the count. Leaving the server does not, and the days keep counting while you are offline.
power.charpowers.time_control.mastery: 1: Slow Down and Gotta Move. 25: Hurry Up. 50: Let Time Flow. 100: Time Block. Every level: Gotta Move's top speed goes up (100% to 1000%). Let Time Flow: 1 chunk, 2 at 75, 3 at 100.
power.charpowers.time_control.quest: At mastery 100, beat a Wither while keeping Slow Down on it the whole fight, without taking a hit.
power.charpowers.time_control.awakening: Attack moves: Barrage and Still Moment.
power.charpowers.time_control.quest_hint: Mastery 100: beat a Wither with Slow Down on it, without taking a hit.
ability.charpowers.slow_down.desc: Slows every mob and player not in your /team by 70%, within 2 chunks of you, for 30 s.
ability.charpowers.gotta_move.desc: A toggle: speeds you up by 100% or more. Hold the key and scroll to set the speed.
ability.charpowers.hurry_up.desc: Mastery 25. Machines within 40 blocks run 5x as fast for 5 minutes (not hoppers, pipes or pistons; spawners only 2x).
ability.charpowers.let_time_flow.desc: Mastery 50. Keeps this chunk loaded for good. Press in that chunk to let it go. /char_chunks shows yours.
ability.charpowers.time_block.desc: Mastery 100. Step outside of time, into a 10x10x10 room that heals you a heart a second. Press again to come back to the same spot.
ability.charpowers.barrage.desc: Awakened. Hits what you are looking at 10 times in a second.
ability.charpowers.still_moment.desc: Awakened. Everything within 16 blocks not in your /team stops for 5 s, then takes 10 hearts at once.

power.charpowers.necromancy.about: Summon the undead and command them to do your misdeeds. They leave everyone alone, friends too, unless you point them at someone: hit someone and they attack too, or look at someone far away and press Point. Stronger at night or in the dark, very weak in sunlight, and they do not burn. They stay until killed or blown up. Hold V (the order wheel) to tell your minions Follow, Stay or Attack what you are looking at.
power.charpowers.necromancy.how: Kill 100 zombies at night without wearing any armour.
power.charpowers.necromancy.mastery: Every level: a little more health and damage. 10: zombies spawn with gear. 25: skeletons shoot 2 arrows a second. 50: Chosen Revival can keep 2. 75: sunlight only weakens them a little. 100: Undead Riot lasts 4 minutes.
power.charpowers.necromancy.quest: At mastery 100, kill a Warden at night with only your summons landing the hits.
power.charpowers.necromancy.awakening: Resurrect dead players: their skin, name and gear (not their powers), and the gear does not drop. A body within 32 blocks of you twitches, then press Chosen Revival.
power.charpowers.necromancy.quest_hint: Mastery 100: kill a Warden at night, with only your summons landing hits.
ability.charpowers.chosen_revival.desc: After you kill something its body might twitch. Press within 30 s to raise it as a summon. Only one at a time.
ability.charpowers.undead_riot.desc: 50 different undead rise within 2 chunks over 10 s, then crumble to dust after 2 minutes.
ability.charpowers.point_undead.desc: Look at someone far away and press: your undead go for them.
ability.charpowers.undead_gear.desc: Mastery 10. Your zombies spawn with gear.
ability.charpowers.fast_arrows.desc: Mastery 25. Your skeletons shoot 2 arrows a second.
ability.charpowers.sun_proof.desc: Mastery 75. Sunlight only weakens them a little.
ability.charpowers.raise_players.desc: Awakened. Chosen Revival works on dead players: their skin, name and gear, not their powers.

power.charpowers.mob_control.about: Control the mobs you meet. You have night vision, and mobs are not hostile towards you, unless you hit them first. The higher your mastery, the bigger the mobs that leave you alone. Hold V (the order wheel) to tell your pets Follow, Stay, Guard or Attack what you are looking at. Feed a hurt pet its favourite food (meat for meat eaters, plants for plant eaters) to heal it. Right-click a saddled or big pet (Ravager, Hoglin, Zoglin) with an empty hand to ride it, and look where you want to go.
power.charpowers.mob_control.how: Tame one of every tameable animal: wolf, cat, parrot, horse, donkey, mule and llama.
power.charpowers.mob_control.mastery: Level 1: normal mobs leave you alone. 50: tough ones (Ravager, Piglin Brute, Elder Guardian). 100: bosses (Warden, Wither, Ender Dragon). Every level: command from further away (10 to 50 blocks). Pets: 1 at the start, up to 5 at 100. Ride: ground mobs first, flying mobs at 50. Swap minds: 30 s, up to 3 minutes at 100.
power.charpowers.mob_control.quest: At mastery 100, win a raid with 5 pets doing all the fighting, never hitting anything yourself.
power.charpowers.mob_control.awakening: Bosses can be ridden and kept as pets, and you can command a whole group at once.
power.charpowers.mob_control.quest_hint: Mastery 100: win a raid with 5 pets, never hitting anything yourself.
ability.charpowers.command_mob.desc: Look at someone and press: the nearest mob attacks them.
ability.charpowers.ride_mob.desc: Look at a mob and press to ride and steer it, even a creeper or a ghast. Press again, or crouch, to get off.
ability.charpowers.pet_follower.desc: Look at a mob and press: it follows you like a pet and fights for you. Press on your own pet to let it go.
ability.charpowers.swap_minds.desc: Look at a mob and press: see through its eyes and walk around as it for 30 s. Press again to come back.
ability.charpowers.mob_peace.desc: Night vision, and mobs are not hostile towards you. Bigger mobs at higher mastery.
ability.charpowers.boss_tamer.desc: Awakened. Bosses can be ridden and kept as pets, and Command moves every mob in range.

power.charpowers.death_steal.about: When a person or mob kills you, you take one of their powers. You wake in an all-black room with a white floor, with a podium for each power they have. Icons spin so they never face you, and you choose by punching one, so you can't pick the best. It TAKES the power: the killer loses it. A mob with no hidden power gives you nothing, and it only works once per person or mob.
power.charpowers.death_steal.how: It awakens by itself: a 1 in 1000 chance each Minecraft day (about 330 hours of play).
power.charpowers.death_steal.mastery: Goes up each time you steal, and from using powers you have stolen. 25: one icon faces you for a split second. 75: two icons face you for a moment. 90: you can steal twice from the same person or mob. 100: you see every icon and choose properly.
power.charpowers.death_steal.quest: At mastery 100, find a way to die by your own hand, then punch the Death Steal icon. The icons never show themselves, and the more powers you have stolen, the more there are.
power.charpowers.death_steal.awakening: What you take is a copy: the killer keeps theirs too.
power.charpowers.death_steal.quest_hint: Mastery 100: die by your own hand, then find the right icon.
ability.charpowers.steal_power.desc: When someone or something with powers kills you, you wake in the black room. Punch an icon to take that power.
ability.charpowers.peek_one.desc: Mastery 25. One icon faces you for a split second.
ability.charpowers.peek_two.desc: Mastery 75. Two icons face you for a moment.
ability.charpowers.steal_twice.desc: Mastery 90. You can steal twice from the same person or mob.
ability.charpowers.see_all.desc: Mastery 100. You see every icon and choose properly.
ability.charpowers.keep_theirs.desc: Awakened. The killer keeps their power too.

power.charpowers.invincible_armour.about: A suit of armour so strong you're practically invincible. It loses 1% battery a minute, you have to take it off and put it on a charging station to charge it, you can't run in it, only walk (and the suit is heavy: Slowness V at mastery 1, easing to Slowness I at 100), and the longer you wear it the crazier you get. Charging resets that. Modules unlock its powers: craft one together with the suit in a crafting table. While you wear the whole suit in first person, a see-through visor shows your battery, modules, mastery, a compass, what you are looking at and what is near: /suitvisor opens its settings (Minimal, Standard or Full, or switch each part).
power.charpowers.invincible_armour.how: Craft the 4 suit parts (crazy expensive: Vibranium, Titanium and Gravestone parts, see JEI), put them together into the one suit, and put it on.
power.charpowers.invincible_armour.maste: Every level: the battery drains a bit slower (1% a minute down to 0.5%), you go crazy a bit slower, and the suit weighs less on you (Slowness V at level 1 down to Slowness I at 100). Module slots: 1, then 2 at 25, 3 at 50, 4 at 75. 100: call the suit from anywhere in this dimension.
power.charpowers.invincible_armour.quest: At mastery 100, wear the suit and survive a nuke. It only comes once you are ready, with a 1 in 1000 chance every second while you wear the suit (about 17 minutes). It does 50 hearts. It does not matter how you survive.
power.charpowers.invincible_armour.awake: A slimmer suit you can slightly run in: crouch and right-click a charging station with the suit, and 4 Vibranium Ingots in your bag.
power.charpowers.invincible_armour.quest: Mastery 100: wear the suit and live through the nuke when it comes.
ability.charpowers.call_suit.desc: The suit flies in as a folded bundle and rises up behind you, opens like a shell, closes round you from behind and drops its helmet on, out of the sky if it was in your bag or from its charging station. Near you at first, anywhere in this dimension at mastery 100. Crouch and press while wearing it to send it away again: the helmet lifts off, the shell opens behind you and it flies back to its station.
ability.charpowers.throw_mob.desc: Strength module. Look at a mob and press to lift it. Press again to throw it.
ability.charpowers.module_strength.desc: Harder punches, and you can lift and throw mobs.
ability.charpowers.module_speed.desc: Walk faster. You still can not run.
ability.charpowers.going_crazy.desc: 1 hour: the screen flickers. 2 hours: whispers in chat. 3 hours: fake mobs that are not really there. Later: the suit moves or attacks on its own. Charging resets it.
ability.charpowers.slim_suit.desc: Awakened. A slimmer suit you can slightly run in.

power.charpowers.green_lantern.about: A ring that lets you make constructs from the power of your will. You can fly, you get your own suit, and an empty hand mines like iron tools. Everything costs battery: hold the Power Battery lantern in your off hand and say your oath in chat to refill it.
power.charpowers.green_lantern.how: Fight a Warden, get it under 5 hearts, then walk 30 blocks away without hitting it again. If you kill it you fail, but you can try again with another Warden. The Warden digs into the ground, a ring flies down onto your hand, and you get the lantern.
power.charpowers.green_lantern.mastery: Every level: constructs hit a little harder and the battery gets bigger (up to 200%). 10: hands hit a bigger area. 25: launch up to 15 swords. 50: bubble up to 30 blocks wide. 75: two turrets at once. 100: the Nuke costs 30% battery.
power.charpowers.green_lantern.quest: At mastery 100 Sinestro comes for you at nightfall. Beat him using only constructs, without the battery reaching 0, then say your oath over him. If he wins he comes back another night.
power.charpowers.green_lantern.awakening: More constructs: Fist Field, Sword Rain and a third turret.
power.charpowers.green_lantern.quest_hin: Sinestro comes at nightfall. Beat him with constructs only, keep your battery above 0, then say your oath over him.
ability.charpowers.rising_fist.desc: A fist blasts up through the ground and launches everything on it. 5%.
ability.charpowers.backhand_slap.desc: An arm appears beside them and backhands them far sideways. 5%.
ability.charpowers.hand_slam.desc: An arm appears above them and slams down palm-first. 5%.
ability.charpowers.hand_throw.desc: Snatch a mob or player. Tap to throw it where you look. Hold to carry it (1% a second), let go to throw. 5%.
ability.charpowers.construct_sword.desc: A big floating greatsword swings for you: left-click for a combo. Press again to put it away. No other abilities while it is out. 10%.
ability.charpowers.launch_swords.desc: Hold to build up swords behind you, let go to fire them all where you look. 10-20%.
ability.charpowers.minigun.desc: A construct minigun in your hands: hold right-click to fire. Press again to put it away. No other abilities while you hold it. 10%, then 5% a second while firing.
ability.charpowers.turret.desc: Builds itself where you look and shoots hostile mobs within 16 blocks. Goes away when you are more than 16 blocks from it. 20%.
ability.charpowers.bubble.desc: A dome up to 20 blocks wide where you look. Nothing gets in or out. Press again to pop it. 1% a second.
ability.charpowers.nuke.desc: 3 s fuse, 100 block radius, breaks no blocks. Hurts everyone, you too. Being inside a Bubble keeps you safe. 50%.
ability.charpowers.gl_flight.desc: The ring lets you fly, but only while your suit is on.
ability.charpowers.gl_tools.desc: An empty hand mines like iron tools, whichever the block wants.

power.charpowers.book_keeping.about: Keep moments in a book and bring time back to them. Write a page to save yourself as you are: where you are, health, hunger, XP, effects and inventory. Restore it and everything YOU did since is undone: blocks you placed or broke, chests you opened, mobs you killed. When you die your things go into the book, and walking back to where you died returns them.
power.charpowers.book_keeping.how: There is one book in the whole world, in a run-down room hidden underground, somewhere between 3,000 and 30,000 blocks from spawn. Nothing shows above ground. Right-click the book to read it.
power.charpowers.book_keeping.mastery: Pages: 1, then 2 at 25, 3 at 50, 4 at 75, 5 at 100. Every level: you get death items back from further away (2 chunks up to 4 at 100). It goes up while you have a page written.
power.charpowers.book_keeping.quest: Not decided yet. Char's plan: find the book's torn-out last page in a second underground dungeon.
ability.charpowers.open_book.desc: See your pages: write one, or restore one. Restoring and writing both delete any deaths the book is holding.
ability.charpowers.book_holds_deaths.des: When you die your items go into the book, each death with its own spot. Walk back within range and they return.
ability.charpowers.no_dupes.desc: Items you throw or give away carry an invisible mark, and vanish if you restore past that moment. So does anything crafted from them.

power.charpowers.game_player.about: Your own world, with gates to clear, weapons only you can wield, and a shop only you can see. To everyone else you look like anyone else, and nothing about this involves them: only one person in a world can be the Player, and only they see the screen, the notifications, the gates, and what's behind them. Daily quests and a story chain give points, and points buy stats (strength, speed, health, defence, luck) with no limit, and skills like Dash, Double Jump and Auto Pickup. It can look like a video-game status window of glowing blue panels, or like normal Minecraft: there's a button to switch.
power.charpowers.game_player.how: Each time you walk into a dungeon there's a 1 in 1000 chance a gate opens that only you can see, and you're told. Walk through it. In the room behind it, crouch on the altar and stay: it takes you down to half a heart. If there's already a Player in this world, no gate will ever open for you.
power.charpowers.game_player.mastery: Every level: quests give a few more points. 25: 4 daily quests and Raise Shadow. 50: 5 daily quests. 75: a second story chain. 100: an extra skill slot. It goes up while you play and for every quest you finish.
power.charpowers.game_player.quest: Finish the whole story chain at mastery 100, then the next dungeon you walk into has a gate only you can see. Beat the boss behind it.
power.charpowers.game_player.awakening: The player shop: special quests pay coins, and coins buy items, from any mod (config/charpowers/game_shop.txt).
power.charpowers.game_player.quest_hint: Finish the story, then a gate waits in a dungeon, with a boss behind it.

Costs tool wear and hunger for every block, and the drops land at your feet.

power.charpowers.house_builder.about: Raise a whole house from nothing: walls, roof, floors, stairs and working doors, in under half a minute, for free. Inside they are empty, the furnishing is yours. They clear plants and small bumps on the plot, and never overwrite anything built or anything that holds things. One 10 minute cooldown for the whole power.
power.charpowers.house_builder.mastery: Every block you place is mastery (100,000 blocks reaches 100). Houses: Cosy Cottage at 1, Oak Timber House at 25, Mountain Lodge at 50, Farmhouse with Barn at 75, Tudor Manor at 100.
power.charpowers.house_builder.quest: At mastery 100, build a real castle: over 50 stacks (3,200) of your own blocks placed since mastery 90, walls at least 5 high on 2 sides or round a courtyard, at least 2 towers taller than the walls, and a doorway. Look at it and use Inspect Castle: it tells you what is missing.
power.charpowers.house_builder.awakening: Five finer houses: Pagoda House, Wizard Tower, Canal Merchant House, Cherry Blossom Villa, Manor with Towers.
power.charpowers.house_builder.quest_hin: Mastery 100: build a castle and use Inspect Castle on it.

Bricklayer: Every block you place counts towards mastery.
